{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
df_clean = df[~df['revenue'].isin([999999.99])]

# Drop refunded orders (they are not completed, so not converted)
completed_only = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()

# Print results
print(f'Conversion rates by segment (after removing QA and refunded orders):\n{conversion_rates}')
print(f'\nHighest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment}')"}
